English: Root Cellar
A makeshift earthen cellar dug beneath the city, offering basic food storage and protection from spoilage.
Grain Store
A timber-framed storehouse for grains and produce, ensuring a more reliable food supply for the growing town.
Garden Plot
A humble patch of tilled earth, tended by hand, where settlers coax meager crops from the wild soil.
Orchard Grove
Rows of fruit trees cultivated on the outskirts, bringing seasonal abundance and improved trade for the city.
Millhouse
A sturdy water or wind-powered mill, grinding grain into flour and driving the citys economic growth.
Bakery Row
A bustling row of communal ovens and bakeries, filling the streets with bread and furthering urban prosperity.
Granary
A massive, stone-built granary dominating the city center, securing the food supply against famine and siege.
Brewers Den
A thriving district of brewers and alehouses, drawing travelers and merchants with the promise of drink and revelry.
Butchers Market
A bustling covered market where butchers ply their trade, distributing meats and provisions throughout the city.
Provisioners Hall
A grand civic hall overseeing all urban provisioning, food stores, and trade. Ensures abundance in times of feast and hardship alike.
